name: image-sizing
description: Local Quartz 5 transformer plugin that applies Obsidian's `![alt|width]`/`![alt|widthxheight]` image-resize syntax to plain markdown images. obsidian-flavored-markdown only parses this syntax for wikilink embeds (`![[img.png|alt|width]]`), not for standard `![alt|width](img.png)` markdown images, so the width/height silently never applied for the latter.

quartz.name: image-sizing
quartz.description: Parses Obsidian's alt-text width/height suffix on plain markdown images and applies it as real width/height attributes.
